# Docker images the integration tests pin. The tests read floci/floci and floci/floci-az from
# here (flociaws/images_test.go, flociaz/images_test.go) and CI pulls every line, so each tag is
# declared once. One image:tag per line; '#' comments and blank lines are ignored. The library
# defaults stay floci/floci:latest and floci/floci-az:latest; the examples use them too, as
# user-facing code.
floci/floci:2.2.0
floci/floci-az:0.14.0
